answer: An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 7 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. The forge counter is kept in jade and onyx exposes each threshold crossing. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. Each duplicate costs another 177 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
